name: Scale
summary: Customers are real, the team is growing, and coordination — not code — is the bottleneck. The founder's rung is leader (give away your Legos). Everything Scale adds is symptom-gated: present when earned, dormant until its trigger, exactly like the team layer is dormant-solo. Authored so far (slices 1–2): the operate loop's core — /incident (the blameless one-page post-mortem for an outage) and the /triage --feedback customer register (bug / friction / feature-request-as-EVID-not-spec / churn) — plus the Scale working rules (high-risk paths, DRI on decisions, and the demotions Scale refuses) and an unlock that names its own evidence bar first. Trigger-gated, NOT yet authored (slices 3–5, each waiting on a real project's symptom): /economics, collaborator roles + mentor-operations + onboarding briefs, /code-health, /refactor-wave, RFC-NNN, and the give-away-your-Legos conscience moment.
graduationHint: There is no next unlock. From here the loop is: operate honestly, delegate deliberately, and let /boss-learn carry what you've proven back UP.
